verdict.line: You lose the fight you force into an up Riposte, and you win the one you start the instant it's down.

brief.thesis: This matchup is a Riposte-timing duel, not a stat check: 48.2% over 114 games is Kled's honest number because the lane swings entirely on whether he trades into W (Riposte) up or down. Fiora wins any exchange where she can parry your first auto or your Q hook; you win every exchange where her Riposte is already burned, because Jousting's double-dash and Violent Tendencies' attack speed both punish a champion with no active cooldown to hide behind.

theirWindow.when: Riposte available, she's near full resource
theirWindow.what: She can bait your first auto or your Q throw into a parry for free value and an AD buff. Don't start the fight; farm with E Jousting's dash-through damage instead of autos until she's shown it.

yourWindow.when: She's used Riposte or Lunge in the last ~8-16s
yourWindow.what: Her W is on cooldown (10-6s depending on rank) and her engage tool (Q Lunge, 16-8s) is also down. Throw Q Bear Trap to hook and yank her in, pop W Violent Tendencies for the four-hit attack speed burst, and commit.

powerCurve.note: Riposte punishes any extended early auto trade
Jousting online, Kled's measured solo-kill edge shows
Both ultimates live, trades stay close
Hydra/Cleaver sustain outpaces her early spike
Her split-push offsets your teamfight disruption

start.why: Run in 76.3% of these games at a 46.6% win rate over 103 — the sustain and early AD let you contest short all-in windows without needing to win the full trade.

boots.why: Picked in 83.2% of games (48.5% win rate) — the flat damage reduction blunts Fiora's auto-reliant Duelist healing loop better than Mercury's Treads, since she has no hard CC to dodge.

core.why: Anchors the top path (66.7% win rate in its line) — the health scaling keeps Skaarl's bar fat so you dismount less often during skirmishes.
Stacks armor shred on Jousting's dash-through hits, which matters directly against Fiora's passive sustain-through-damage.
Completes the top-performing core path — the shield covers you through a Blade Waltz burst if she lands her ultimate on you.

situational.when: fiora's Duelist passive is healing her through your trades
you need the grievous wounds earlier than a full Mortal Reminder spike
she's taking Blade Waltz all-ins and you need to survive the burst window
you're ahead and want the crit/bruiser path instead of Titanic's tank stats

runes.keystoneWhy: Run on both top rune pages for this matchup — the stacking adaptive force rewards exactly the extended-trade pattern you want once Riposte is confirmed down.

summoners.why: Run in 74.8% of games at 46.2% win rate — Ignite converts Kled's measured solo-kill advantage into secured kills once you catch her with Riposte down, before her Duelist sustain can heal her back out.

playing.title: Don't feed Riposte
playing.detail: Never throw your first auto or Q Bear Trap into an available Riposte. Farm with E Jousting's dash damage instead until she's used W or Q.

playing.title: All-in the instant Riposte is down
playing.detail: Once she's parried or her W timer reads under 6s remaining, commit immediately — Q hook, W attack speed burst, E double-dash.

playing.title: Track Skaarl's health bar
playing.detail: Watch your own mount HP constantly; fight to build courage before you're forced into a weaker dismounted trade against her sustain.

playing.title: Use Jousting's recast to disengage
playing.detail: If a trade goes bad, E's return dash gets you out before she can stack a second Lunge or burn Burst of Speed to chase.

playing.title: Itemize into her sustain
playing.detail: Prioritize Mortal Reminder or Executioner's Calling the moment her Duelist healing is winning extended skirmishes for her.

playing.title: Threaten global pressure with R
playing.detail: Chaaaaaaaarge!!! has 3500 range — use the threat of it to pull her off safe farming patterns, since her Blade Waltz is on a similarly long cooldown.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners and the win-rate/pick-rate figures above are measured from live games on the current patch (16.20.1); the tell, power curve and trade-pattern reasoning are my own read of the ability kits, not scraped data.

stats.opponentTip: Do not let Fiora hit your Vitals while you are contesting and farming lane.
